_doc: Hand placements of semantics/tools/trace_requirements.py (basis explicit), read from each statement's text, Notes and Source. Placed: every I statement and every P statement the rules and finding bases leave without a target, when an axiom, contract clause, domain clause or functional clause of its module covers it. Principle for premises (kind P): an IRIS engine, driver or third-party fact is traced only to an iris-contract clause that decides it; one outside the validated contract subset stays open (a contract coverage gap, CONTRACT.md 'Outside the semantic subset'), with its reason in open_reasons. A premise that is a product or operator obligation supporting an axiom (callers send the fingerprint, an operator fronts the server with TLS) is traced to that axiom. Requirements left open on purpose are listed in open_reasons with the reason. After the contract-2 lane (validated clauses E-1, S-1, X2-*): statements whose IRIS behaviour a contract-2 clause decides gained that clause; each open statement names the contract-2 outside premise (P2-*) that holds it as assumed, or none with the reason.
